4: /-!
5: # S1968: the actual q_v-determined q-pilot object and the exact first missing of R6
6: 
7: ## The obligation left by S1960
8: 
9: R6 of LeanFormal.IUT.IUTIII.Theorem311.SourceKummerEvaluationArrows
10: (lines 74--75) is the identification of the reduced q-pilot anchor with the
11: paper's q-pilot F^boxplus-triangleright-x-mu-prime-strip of IUT III,
12: Definition 3.8, (i).  S1960 (S1960QPilotAnchorActual) constructed the
13: reduced anchor
14: 
15:   reducedQPilotAnchor D = sourceQPilotStrip (S1895PaperO D).boundary
16:     = (S1895PaperO D).strip = S1895Core I = (paperInput D).fPrimeStripAt 1 0
17:     = lgpStrip D = (paperFullLogKummerUQ D).evaluationSquare.lowerLeft
18: 
19: together with the canonical times-mu lift reducedQPilotTimesMu D and the
20: reduced self-identification reducedAnchorIdentification D; it recorded the
21: paper-side strip as missing and parameterized the R6 interface
22: 
23:   QPilotAnchorIdentification D (paperStrip : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV)
24: 
25: by it.  This file resolves the data question behind that parameter.
26: 
27: ## What this file constructs (all actual, kernel-checked)
28: 
29: 1. **The actual q_v family.**  At every bad place b of the S1527/S1895
30:    input, paperQV D b is the actual Definition 3.1(b)(c) q-parameter
31:    (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter b; it is nonzero, contracting
32:    (norm < 1), and log (norm q) < 0.  Its actual completed-DVR order is
33:    paperQVOrder D b, the order of the actual completion q candidate at the
34:    F-place over b; it equals the S1487/S1391 order S1487Cand.order (S1527),
35:    and |log (q_b)| = order_b * log 5.
36: 
37: 2. **The q-pilot object of IUT III, Definition 3.8, (i), at the object level.**
38:    The q-pilot object is the arithmetic divisor of the zero locus of the
39:    q_v, in the global realified Frobenioid C^boxplus_mod.  The latter is the
40:    actual S1927 object paperGlobalRealifiedFrobenioid D; its divisor monoid is
41:    the actual realified effective divisor monoid
42:    (HeightOneSpectrum O_Fmod ->_0 NNReal) x (InfinitePlace Fmod -> NNReal)
43:    (S1927).  The divisor group used for degrees here is the actual
44:    IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D) of IUT IV, Definition 1.9, with
45:    deg = sum_v c_v * weight v and weight (.finite v) = log (absNorm v).
46: 
47:    * paperQPilotDivisor D is the order-weighted divisor supported on the
48:      actual bad base prime, with coefficients equal to the actual orders
49:      paperQVOrder D b (the bad family of the S1280/S1527 input is the
50:      singleton over the Gaussian place above 5, so the divisor sum over the
51:      bad places is the single displayed term).
52:    * paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source : the degree of paperQPilotDivisor D is
53:      sum_b |log q_b|; through S1527 this is order_C3 * log 5.
54:    * paperQPilotLogVolume D = -deg (paperQPilotDivisor D), which is the
55:      actual source scalar sourceQPilotSignedLog, equal to
56:      -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand = -order_C3 * log 5 < 0: the paper's
57:      q-pilot log-volume -|log q|.
58:    * paperQPilotDivisor_deg_pos and the support statement record that this
59:      q-pilot object is nontrivial and supported exactly on the bad base prime.
60:    * QVDeterminedQPilotObject D packages the divisor, its degree and the
61:      log-volume with the equalities that witness the q_v-determination
62:      (paperQVOrder_abs_log, paperQVOrder_eq_abs_log_div: the coefficient is
63:      |log q_b| / log 5).
64: 
65: 3. **The R6 interface, re-exported for the paper strip.**  R6Proper D P is
66:    Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P).  The exact reduction
67:    r6Proper_iff is S1960's s1960_r6_exact_reduction, and
68:    r6Proper_of_equivalence converts a times-mu equivalence from the reduced
69:    anchor's canonical lift to the paper strip into the R6 identification.
70: 
71: ## The exact first missing (R6 proper remains open)
72: 
73: R6 needs the paper-side times-mu strip *arising from* this q-pilot object
74: (IUT III, Definition 3.8, (i); IUT II, Definition 4.9, (viii), the
75: "associated pilot object" of an F^boxplus-triangleright-x-mu-prime-strip).
76: The first missing is a **definition**, not a proposition:
77: 
78: * (a) the paper-side paperQPilotFTimesMuStrip D : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip
79:   PaperV constructed from the q-pilot object paperQPilotDivisor D, together
80:   with
81: * (b) the identification of its associated pilot object with
82:   paperQPilotDivisor D.
83: 
84: Neither exists in the tree.  SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip has no field for a
85: global arithmetic divisor or a pilot object, its only constructor is
86: SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip.canonical, and the only F-prime-strips available
87: from an OriginalInput are the Hodge-theater strips I.fPrimeStripAt n m.  In
88: the concrete S1487 model those are the shear strips S1487Strip n m, whose
89: value monoid is the constant SourceHaarActualValueMonoid; no functor from the
90: global realified Frobenioid (or from an arithmetic divisor) to a prime strip is
91: constructed anywhere in the tree.  Consequently no honest inhabitant of
92: QPilotAnchorIdentification D P for the paper strip P can be produced here,
93: and this file does **not** declare a paper-side type, an arbitrary inhabitant,
94: a free Prop slot or a Nonempty gate.
95: 
96: ## Obstructions proved here (why no available strip can be R6)
97: 
98: (i) **The reduced anchor's times-mu layer is trivial.**  The anchor's value
99: monoid is SourceHaarActualValueMonoid = Multiplicative {x : Real // x <= 0};
100: its unit group is trivial (x <= 0 and -x <= 0 force x = 0), hence so is
101: (reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v for every v.  It follows that every
102: candidate paper strip satisfying the R6 interface has subsingleton times-mu
103: fibers at every place (r6Proper_forces_trivial_timesMu).  The paper q-pilot
104: x-mu layer is precisely the q_v-determined unit layer, so the present
105: reduced value/unit model cannot host a faithful R6 identification: the missing
106: definition must also change the value/unit model, not merely add a strip.
107: 
108: (ii) **The tree's strips are q_v-blind.**  Replacing only the initial theta
109: data of the S1527 shear input (keeping the actual Hodge-theater family) leaves
110: I.fPrimeStripAt n m definitionally unchanged (withInitial,
111: fPrimeStripAt_withInitial); the concrete witness is S1487FaithfulInput vs
112: S1487TwoPlaceInput: same (1,0) strip, different q-pilot log-volumes
113: (candidate_blind, qPilot_scalar_differs).  Hence no strip available from the
114: tree can be certified as the q_v-determined paper q-pilot strip.
115: 
116: ## Honest scope
117: 
118: No sorry, admit, axiom, True/PUnit slot, empty type, arbitrary inhabitant or
119: assumption-only Nonempty gate is used.  The classical inputs are exactly those
120: already carried by S1895/S1958 (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), see the
121: axiom probes at the end.  R6 proper is **not** claimed closed; the first
122: missing is the definition (a)/(b) above.
123: -/

154: /-! ## 0. The actual q_v data of the S1895 paper input -/
155: 
156: /-- The actual q_v at a bad place of the S1895/S1527 input: the Definition
157: 3.1(b)(c) q-parameter.  These are the scalar q_v of the S1280 Gaussian bad
158: family; S1527 computes q_v = (1/5) ^ order_C3 and
159: |log q_v| = order_C3 * log 5 = localLogMagnitude S1487Cand. -/
160: noncomputable def paperQV (D : S1895PaperInput)
161:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : ℝ :=
162:   (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter b
163: 
164: theorem paperQV_eq_qParameter (D : S1895PaperInput)
165:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
166:     paperQV D b = (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter b := rfl
167: 
168: theorem paperQV_ne_zero (D : S1895PaperInput)
169:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : paperQV D b ≠ 0 :=
170:   (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter_nonzero b
171: 
172: theorem paperQV_norm_lt_one (D : S1895PaperInput)
173:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : ‖paperQV D b‖ < 1 :=
174:   (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter_contracting b
175: 
176: /-- The actual bad q-parameters are contracting, so their logs are negative. -/
177: theorem paperQV_log_neg (D : S1895PaperInput)
178:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : Real.log ‖paperQV D b‖ < 0 :=
179:   Real.log_neg (norm_pos_iff.mpr (paperQV_ne_zero D b)) (paperQV_norm_lt_one D b)
180: 
181: /-- The actual completed-DVR order of the q candidate at the F-place over the
182: bad place b (the exponent of the q parameter).  This is the coefficient of the
183: q-pilot divisor. -/
184: noncomputable def paperQVOrder (D : S1895PaperInput)
185:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : ℕ :=
186:   (badPlaceQCandidate (S1280Selection D.l) b).order
187: 
188: /-- The actual order equals the S1487/S1391 order order_C3 (S1527). -/
189: theorem paperQVOrder_eq_orderC3 (D : S1895PaperInput)
190:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
191:     paperQVOrder D b = S1487Cand.order :=
192:   S1527_badPlaceQCandidate_order_eq D.l b
193: 
194: theorem paperQVOrder_pos (D : S1895PaperInput)
195:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) : 0 < paperQVOrder D b := by
196:   rw [paperQVOrder_eq_orderC3]
197:   exact S1487Cand.order_pos
198: 
199: /-- **The q_v determines the order**: |log q_b| = order_b * log 5. -/
200: theorem paperQVOrder_abs_log (D : S1895PaperInput)
201:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
202:     |Real.log (paperQV D b)| = (paperQVOrder D b : ℝ) * Real.log 5 := by
203:   have h1 : paperQV D b = (S1280ReductionClause D.l).qParameter b := rfl
204:   rw [h1, S1527_abs_log_qParameter]
205:   congr 1
206:   have h2 : S1527OrderC3 = paperQVOrder D b :=
207:     (S1527_badPlaceQCandidate_order_eq D.l b).symm
208:   exact_mod_cast h2
209: 
210: /-- Equivalently, the order is the normalized absolute log of the actual q_v. -/
211: theorem paperQVOrder_eq_abs_log_div (D : S1895PaperInput)
212:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
213:     (paperQVOrder D b : ℝ) = |Real.log (paperQV D b)| / Real.log 5 := by
214:   rw [paperQVOrder_abs_log]
215:   have hlog : Real.log 5 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
216:   field_simp
217: 
218: /-- A chosen bad place: the S1280 bad family is the singleton over the actual
219: Gaussian place above 5, so this choice is the unique bad place. -/
220: noncomputable def paperQVBad0 (D : S1895PaperInput) :
221:     (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces :=
222:   S1527Bad0 D.l
223: 
224: /-! ## 1. The q-pilot object of IUT III, Definition 3.8, (i) -/
225: 
226: /-- The weight of the actual bad base prime in the arithmetic divisor group:
227: log (absNorm v) = log 5, because the bad place is the concrete Gaussian place
228: above 5 (its residue field is ZMod 5). -/
229: theorem paperBadBasePlace_weight (D : S1895PaperInput)
230:     (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
231:     IUTIVPlace.weight (PaperFmod D)
232:       (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D b)) = Real.log 5 := by
233:   have hplace : b.1 = S1487FivePlace.val := by
234:     have hb := S1527_bad_val_eq D.l b
235:     rw [show S1487FivePlace.val = concreteGaussianFivePlace from rfl]
236:     exact hb
237:   have hres : residueNormBase b.1 = 5 := by
238:     rw [hplace]
239:     exact S1487_residueNormBase_five
240:   have hweight : IUTIVPlace.weight (PaperFmod D)
241:       (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D b)) =
242:         Real.log (residueNormBase b.1) := rfl
243:   rw [hweight, hres]
244: 
245: /-- **The actual q-pilot arithmetic divisor** determined by the q_v: the zero
246: locus of the q_v, with the actual completed-DVR orders as coefficients, as an
247: element of the realified arithmetic divisor group of the base field Fmod.
248: The bad family of the S1280/S1527 input is the singleton over the concrete
249: Gaussian place above 5, so the divisor sum over the bad places is the
250: displayed single term. -/
251: noncomputable def paperQPilotDivisor (D : S1895PaperInput) :
252:     IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D) :=
253:   Finsupp.single (IUTIVPlace.finite (F := PaperFmod D)
254:       (paperBadBasePlace D (paperQVBad0 D)))
255:     ((paperQVOrder D (paperQVBad0 D) : ℝ))
256: 
257: /-- The coefficient of the q-pilot divisor at the bad base prime is the actual
258: order of the q_v. -/
259: theorem paperQPilotDivisor_apply (D : S1895PaperInput) :
260:     paperQPilotDivisor D
261:         (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D (paperQVBad0 D))) =
262:       (paperQVOrder D (paperQVBad0 D) : ℝ) := by
263:   rw [paperQPilotDivisor, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
264: 
265: /-- **The degree of the actual q-pilot divisor is |log q|**: it is
266: sum_b |log q_b| = order_C3 * log 5 (S1527). -/
267: theorem paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source (D : S1895PaperInput) :
268:     IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg (F := PaperFmod D) (paperQPilotDivisor D) =
269:       sourceBadQAbsLog (paperInput D).initial := by
270:   rw [paperQPilotDivisor]
271:   change IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.degLinearMap (PaperFmod D)
272:       (Finsupp.single (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D (paperQVBad0 D)))
273:         ((paperQVOrder D (paperQVBad0 D) : ℝ))) = _
274:   rw [IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg_single]
275:   rw [paperBadBasePlace_weight]
276:   have hinit : (paperInput D).initial =
277:       S1527SourceData D.l D.R D.redCompat D.hredCompat D.torCompat D.htorCompat
278:         D.orbCompat D.horbCompat D.secCompat D.hsecCompat D.cusCompat D.hcusCompat := rfl
279:   rw [hinit, S1527_sourceBadQAbsLog]
280:   show (paperQVOrder D (paperQVBad0 D) : ℝ) * Real.log 5 =
281:     (S1487Cand.order : ℝ) * Real.log 5
282:   rw [paperQVOrder_eq_orderC3]
283: 
284: /-- The q-pilot divisor has positive degree. -/
285: theorem paperQPilotDivisor_deg_pos (D : S1895PaperInput) :
286:     0 < IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg (F := PaperFmod D) (paperQPilotDivisor D) := by
287:   rw [paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source]
288:   exact sourceBadQAbsLog_pos_of_nonempty (paperInput D).initial ⟨paperQVBad0 D⟩
289: 
290: /-- **The q-pilot log-volume -|log q|**, as the negative degree of the actual
291: q-pilot divisor. -/
292: noncomputable def paperQPilotLogVolume (D : S1895PaperInput) : ℝ :=
293:   -sourceBadQAbsLog (paperInput D).initial
294: 
295: theorem paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_signedLog (D : S1895PaperInput) :
296:     paperQPilotLogVolume D = sourceQPilotSignedLog (paperInput D).initial := rfl
297: 
298: theorem paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_neg_deg (D : S1895PaperInput) :
299:     paperQPilotLogVolume D =
300:       - IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg (F := PaperFmod D) (paperQPilotDivisor D) := by
301:   rw [paperQPilotLogVolume, paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source]
302: 
303: /-- The q-pilot log-volume is -order_C3 * log 5 = -|log q| (S1527). -/
304: theorem paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_orderC3 (D : S1895PaperInput) :
305:     paperQPilotLogVolume D = -((S1487Cand.order : ℝ) * Real.log 5) := by
306:   rw [paperQPilotLogVolume]
307:   have hinit : (paperInput D).initial =
308:       S1527SourceData D.l D.R D.redCompat D.hredCompat D.torCompat D.htorCompat
309:         D.orbCompat D.horbCompat D.secCompat D.hsecCompat D.cusCompat D.hcusCompat := rfl
310:   rw [hinit, S1527_sourceBadQAbsLog, S1527OrderC3_eq]
311: 
312: /-- The q-pilot log-volume is literally the negative of the actual S1487/S1391
313: completion log magnitude. -/
314: theorem paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_neg_localLogMagnitude (D : S1895PaperInput) :
315:     paperQPilotLogVolume D = -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand := by
316:   rw [paperQPilotLogVolume]
317:   have hinit : (paperInput D).initial =
318:       S1527SourceData D.l D.R D.redCompat D.hredCompat D.torCompat D.htorCompat
319:         D.orbCompat D.horbCompat D.secCompat D.hsecCompat D.cusCompat D.hcusCompat := rfl
320:   rw [hinit, S1527_sourceBadQAbsLog_eq_localLogMagnitude]
321: 
322: /-- The paper q-pilot log-volume is strictly negative. -/
323: theorem paperQPilotLogVolume_neg (D : S1895PaperInput) :
324:     paperQPilotLogVolume D < 0 := by
325:   rw [paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_orderC3]
326:   have hlog : 0 < Real.log 5 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
327:   have horder : 0 < (S1487Cand.order : ℝ) := by
328:     exact_mod_cast S1487Cand.order_pos
329:   nlinarith
330: 
331: /-- The actual q_v-determined q-pilot object of IUT III, Definition 3.8, (i):
332: the order-weighted arithmetic divisor of the zero locus of the q_v in the
333: global realified Frobenioid, its degree |log q| and its log-volume -|log q|.
334: This is the **object**; it is not the paper's
335: F^boxplus-triangleright-x-mu-prime-strip (that strip is the exact first
336: missing, see the module docstring). -/
337: structure QVDeterminedQPilotObject (D : S1895PaperInput) where
338:   /-- the q-pilot arithmetic divisor determined by the actual q_v -/
339:   divisor : IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D)
340:   /-- it is the zero-locus divisor with the actual orders -/
341:   divisor_eq : divisor = paperQPilotDivisor D
342:   /-- its degree is sum_b |log q_b| -/
343:   degree : ℝ
344:   degree_eq : degree =
345:     IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg (F := PaperFmod D) (paperQPilotDivisor D)
346:   degree_eq_abs_sum : degree = sourceBadQAbsLog (paperInput D).initial
347:   /-- the paper q-pilot log-volume -|log q| -/
348:   logVolume : ℝ
349:   logVolume_eq : logVolume = paperQPilotLogVolume D
350:   logVolume_eq_neg_degree : logVolume = -degree
351: 
352: /-- The q_v-determined q-pilot object is inhabited for every S1895 input. -/
353: noncomputable def qvDeterminedQPilotObject (D : S1895PaperInput) :
354:     QVDeterminedQPilotObject D where
355:   divisor := paperQPilotDivisor D
356:   divisor_eq := rfl
357:   degree := IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg (F := PaperFmod D) (paperQPilotDivisor D)
358:   degree_eq := rfl
359:   degree_eq_abs_sum := paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source D
360:   logVolume := paperQPilotLogVolume D
361:   logVolume_eq := rfl
362:   logVolume_eq_neg_degree := paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_neg_deg D
363: 
364: theorem qvDeterminedQPilotObject_exists (D : S1895PaperInput) :
365:     Nonempty (QVDeterminedQPilotObject D) :=
366:   ⟨qvDeterminedQPilotObject D⟩
367: 
368: theorem qvDeterminedQPilotObject_divisor (D : S1895PaperInput) :
369:     (qvDeterminedQPilotObject D).divisor = paperQPilotDivisor D := rfl
370: 
371: theorem qvDeterminedQPilotObject_logVolume (D : S1895PaperInput) :
372:     (qvDeterminedQPilotObject D).logVolume =
373:       sourceQPilotSignedLog (paperInput D).initial := rfl
374: 
375: /-! ## 2. The R6 interface for a paper-side strip -/
376: 
377: /-- R6 proper, as a predicate on a candidate paper-side q-pilot times-mu strip:
378: the reduced q-pilot anchor is identified with the paper strip.  It is the
379: interface of S1960, parameterized by the paper strip because that strip is not
380: defined in the tree. -/
381: def R6Proper (D : S1895PaperInput)
382:     (paperStrip : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV) : Prop :=
383:   Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D paperStrip)
384: 
385: /-- R6 proper is exactly the nonemptiness of the times-mu equivalence class
386: (S1960's exact reduction). -/
387: theorem r6Proper_iff (D : S1895PaperInput)
388:     (paperStrip : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV) :
389:     R6Proper D paperStrip ↔
390:       Nonempty (SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripEquivalence
391:         (reducedQPilotTimesMu D) paperStrip) :=
392:   s1960_r6_exact_reduction D paperStrip
393: 
394: /-- A times-mu equivalence from the reduced anchor's canonical lift to the
395: paper strip gives the R6 identification.  This is the last step that the
396: missing definition of the paper strip has to feed. -/
397: theorem r6Proper_of_equivalence (D : S1895PaperInput)
398:     (paperStrip : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV)
399:     (e : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripEquivalence (reducedQPilotTimesMu D) paperStrip) :
400:     R6Proper D paperStrip :=
401:   (s1960_r6_exact_reduction D paperStrip).mpr ⟨e⟩
402: 
403: /-- A full poly-isomorphism is of course also an R6 identification. -/
404: theorem r6Proper_of_fullPolyIso (D : S1895PaperInput)
405:     (paperStrip : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV)
406:     (phi : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism
407:       (reducedQPilotTimesMu D) paperStrip) :
408:     R6Proper D paperStrip :=
409:   ⟨phi⟩
410: 
411: /-- The reduced self-identification inhabits the R6 interface at the reduced
412: anchor's own lift.  This is S1960's qPilotAnchorSelfIdentification; it is
413: **not** R6, because the paper side is the reduced anchor itself. -/
414: theorem r6Proper_reducedSelf (D : S1895PaperInput) :
415:     R6Proper D (reducedQPilotTimesMu D) :=
416:   ⟨qPilotAnchorSelfIdentification D⟩
417: 
418: /-! ## 3. The reduced anchor's times-mu layer is trivial
419:

419	
420	The value monoid of the reduced anchor is SourceHaarActualValueMonoid, the
421	nonpositive reals under addition (multiplicatively).  Its unit group is
422	trivial, hence the whole x-mu (times-mu) layer of the reduced anchor is
423	trivial.  This is an actual property of the S1487 shear strip on which the
424	reduced anchor is based, and it is the reason the available reduced model
425	cannot host a faithful R6 identification. -/

427	/-- The unit group of the concrete nonpositive value monoid is trivial. -/
428	instance instSubsingletonSourceHaarUnits :
429	    Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) := by
430	  constructor
431	  intro a b
432	  have key : ∀ u : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ,
433	      (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 1 := by
434	    intro u
435	    have hmul : ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) *
436	        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)) = 1 :=
437	      Units.mul_inv u
438	    have hta : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) *
439	        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) :
440	          SourceHaarActualValueMonoid))).toAdd = 0 := by
441	      rw [hmul]
442	      rfl
443	    rw [toAdd_mul] at hta
444	    have hx : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
445	      ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd.property
446	    have hy : ((((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) :
447	        SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
448	      (((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) :
449	        SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd.property
450	    have hsum : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) +
451	        ((((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) :
452	          SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) = 0 := by
453	      have h := congrArg (fun z : sourceHaarActualNonpositiveAddSubmonoid => (z : ℝ)) hta
454	      simpa using h
455	    have hzero : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) = 0 := by linarith
456	    have h0 : ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd = 0 := Subtype.ext hzero
457	    calc (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)
458	        = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid).toAdd) := rfl
459	      _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0 := by rw [h0]
460	      _ = 1 := rfl
461	  apply Units.ext
462	  exact (key a).trans (key b).symm
